## 這個 Pull Request 做了什麼 / What this pull request does

<!-- 簡單說明修改的內容與原因。如果對應某個 Issue，請寫上 Closes #編號 -->
<!-- Briefly describe the change and why. If it fixes an issue, write Closes #number -->

## 類型 / Type

- [ ] 勘誤（錯字、格式） / Erratum (typo, formatting)
- [ ] 內容（修正技術錯誤、新增或改寫內容） / Content (technical fix, new or rewritten content)
- [ ] 練習檔 / Practice files
- [ ] 圖片 / Figure
- [ ] 翻譯 / Translation
- [ ] 專案文件、腳本或設定 / Project documents, scripts or settings

## 檢查清單 / Checklist

- [ ] 已執行 `python3 scripts/check_book.py`，沒有錯誤 / `python3 scripts/check_book.py` passes
- [ ] 遵守寫作規範（STYLE_GUIDE.md） / Follows the style guide (STYLE_GUIDE.md)
- [ ] 內容不包含機密資訊、PDK 資料、商用 EDA 工具名稱或截圖、未經授權的圖片 / Contains no confidential information, PDK data, commercial EDA tool names or screenshots, or unlicensed images
- [ ] 技術內容的修改，已附上公開資料或實際執行的結果 / Technical changes include public references or real output
- [ ] 修改了「跟著做」或 `practice/` 時，`bash practice/run_all.sh` 全部通過 / If Try-it sections or `practice/` changed, `bash practice/run_all.sh` passes
- [ ] 新增的術語已加入術語總表 / New terms are added to the glossary
- [ ] 修改中文原文時，已同步各語言版本，或在說明中註明需要同步 / If the Chinese original changed, the translations are synced or the need to sync is noted
- [ ] （翻譯）翻譯完成的檔案已執行 `--stamp`，結構比對沒有差異 / (Translations) finished files are stamped and the structure check passes
